targets.title: Strong convergence rate of the fractional WIS Euler integrator
targets.outcome: Improved fractional WIS Euler terminal rate proved for Lipschitz drift

targets.title: Coboundary expansion of random balanced Cayley complexes
targets.outcome: Elementary abelian2-groups deterministically refute the proposed uniform random coboundary-expansion assertion.

targets.title: Zero in the upper-Laplacian spectrum of low-degree simplicial complexes
targets.outcome: Counterexample on a countable pure three-complex: maximum triangle degree three, coercive normalized upper Laplacian on the full weighted space, and trivial kernel.

targets.title: Topological complexity in the homogeneous medial regime for all sample sizes
targets.outcome: The reduced topological complexity is2 with probability tending to one along all sample sizes in the homogeneous lower model.

targets.title: A finite three-ample complex with nontrivial fundamental group
targets.outcome: Finite 32768-vertex three-ample simplicial complex with a simplicial retract onto a four-cycle.

targets.title: Connectivity when the last isolated point disappears in a polytope
targets.outcome: For every fixed full-dimensional convex polytope in every fixed dimension at least three, connectivity occurs exactly when the last isolated vertex disappears with high probability.

targets.title: Location of the most isolated point in a random polyhedral sample
targets.outcome: Both noncritical spatial limits for the actual most-isolated point, with the stated tie rule.

targets.title: Vanishing threshold for first path homology of a random digraph
targets.outcome: Rational nonregular first path homology vanishes with high probability throughout the requested exponent range above minus two-thirds.

targets.title: Central limit theorem for the first path Betti number
targets.outcome: Rational nonregular first path Betti number CLT with true mean and variance for every requested density sequence, with variance asymptotic to the edge-count variance.
